title: Someone help this stupid developer in Korea!

posts.author: nonamQu
posts.body:
Hello.
Dear senior developers from faraway countries.
I am a beginner developer who is making my first game with RPG Maker mz with a small team in South Korea.
I want to implement the following functions, but I haven't found or made a plugin with similar functions yet. If you know of a solution related to this, please help me!
I believe that you can help me with your amazing wisdom.
P.S. I am not familiar with thread-type communities, so I may not have been able to utilize the features of this community well. Please understand this.
~What I want to make~
1. Delete the battle commands in the basic RPG Maker.
2. Create optional commands named Attack, Defense, Skill, and Item.
3. When you select the Attack command, skills with skill type 01 are displayed in the database.
4. When you select the Defense command, skills with skill type 04 are displayed in the database.
5. When you select the Skill command, skill types 02 and 03 are displayed.
6. The item function is the same as the basic one.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Do you intend to use VisuStella plugins? 'VS Battle Core' lets you set the battle commands per class. It has options like 'SType: X'.
For naming and combining skill types, I think you can make skills with names 'Attack', 'Defense', 'Skill' and then use 'VS Skill Containers' plugin to make them open those lists with anything you've set inside. But research it before you buy it
I bet there are other plugins that let you do that as well (you might also search some japanese plugins).
EDIT: Wait, I actually googled it and it says "Skill Containers cannot be used as Single Skill Commands for the VisuMZ Battle Core's Actor Command Window (just use a Skill Type instead)". So yeah, you need to look for alternatives if you want to combine skill types under one command.
EDIT2: VS SKill and States allows you to set multiple skill types to skills. So if you want to show both skill types 2 and 3, you could make those also be skill type 11 and then use the 'VS Battle Core' to show skill type 11.
